_note: Hover help for this project's buttons, menu items and tabs (project-owned). Key = the control's text, optionally preceded by where it is: tab / sub-tab / group box titles (outermost first) or a dialog's title, joined with ' > '. The most specific match wins; '&', a trailing '...' and case are ignored. An empty text = no tooltip on purpose. Engine controls (developer buttons, Environment tab, OK / Cancel / Close ...) already have entries in Base\Services_ToolTips.psm1; an entry here overrides them. Buttons made with a Tip (New-SamButton) keep that tip. The developer build lists every control still missing one in <data root>\Logs\ToolTips_missing.txt.

ToolTips.Overview: What this tool does and the order of the pipeline steps.
ToolTips.Update Pipeline: Move new application versions from Incoming to SCCM: pull, update JSON, upload, create, deploy.
ToolTips.Software: Every application in the site with versions, deployments and content.
ToolTips.Collections: Every collection with member and deployment counts.
ToolTips.Devices: Every device record with its client state and collections.
ToolTips.Environment > SCCM Site: This environment's site code, SMS Provider server, paths and defaults.
ToolTips.Scan / Refresh: Re-read the JSON files and compare Incoming / Local / Repository / SCCM.
ToolTips.1. Pull from Incoming: Copy the newer version folders from the Incoming share to Local Root (robocopy).
ToolTips.2. Update JSON: Point each application's JSON at its new local version (reviewed before saving).
ToolTips.3. Upload to Repository: Copy the version folders from Local Root to the repository share (robocopy).
ToolTips.4. Create in SCCM: Create the application and its script deployment type in SCCM from the JSON.
ToolTips.5. Deploy: Open the deploy window: collection, Required / Available and times.
ToolTips.Copy JSON to environment: Make a JSON for another site from the selected rows (paths re-pointed, reviewed first).
ToolTips.Clear Selection: Select no rows (steps then run for every row that needs them).
ToolTips.Open local folder: Open the application's folder under Local Root in Explorer.
ToolTips.Open repository folder: Open the application's folder in the repository in Explorer.
ToolTips.Open JSON in Notepad: Open the application's JSON file in Notepad.
ToolTips.Show in Software tab: Jump to this application on the Software tab.
ToolTips.Copy application name(s): Copy the selected application names to the clipboard.
ToolTips.Activity: Open the activity log in its own window.
ToolTips.Deploy: Deploy the selected application(s) to a collection (asks for the collection, purpose and times).
ToolTips.Export to JSON: Write <Local Root>\<AppBaseName>_<SITE>.json for the selected application(s) (read-only in SCCM).
ToolTips.Show deployments: List the deployments of the selected item.
ToolTips.Show device install status: List the devices targeted by this application and their install state.
ToolTips.Export config to JSON (pipeline): Write <Local Root>\<AppBaseName>_<SITE>.json for the selected application(s) (read-only in SCCM).
ToolTips.Distribute content to DP group: Send the selected applications' content to this environment's distribution point group.
ToolTips.Update content on distribution points: Re-send the content after files in the content folder changed.
ToolTips.Copy name(s): Copy the selected names to the clipboard.
ToolTips.Copy ID(s): Copy the selected collection IDs to the clipboard.
ToolTips.Retire: Retire the selected applications: existing installs stay, they can no longer be deployed.
ToolTips.Delete application(s): PERMANENTLY delete the selected applications (only ones with no deployments). Repository content is not touched.
ToolTips.Show members: List the members of this collection with their install status.
ToolTips.Add devices: Add devices to this collection by picking them or pasting names.
ToolTips.Deploy software to this collection: Pick applications and deploy them to this collection.
ToolTips.Update membership now: Ask the site to evaluate this collection's membership now.
ToolTips.Delete collection(s): PERMANENTLY delete the selected collections (only ones with no deployments that limit nothing).
ToolTips.Add to collection: Add the selected devices to a collection.
ToolTips.Show collections: List the collections this device is in.
ToolTips.Show deployments and status: List the deployments that target this device and their state.
ToolTips.Remove from collection: Remove the selected devices from one of their direct collections (admin).
ToolTips.Clear PXE deployments: Clear required PXE deployments so the devices can PXE boot again (admin).
ToolTips.Delete device record(s): PERMANENTLY delete the selected device records from the site (admin).
ToolTips.Remove selected: Remove the selected DIRECT members from this collection (admin).
ToolTips.Check all shown: Tick every device shown in the list.
ToolTips.Hide current members: Leave out devices that are already in the collection.
ToolTips.Load from file: Read device names from a text or CSV file.
ToolTips.Check & Add: Look the names up in SCCM, then show what will be added.
ToolTips.Available: Offer it in Software Center; nothing installs on its own.
ToolTips.Use NEW value: Use the new value for this field (untick to keep the current one).
ToolTips.Open log folder: Open the folder with the activity and robocopy logs in Explorer.
ToolTips.Clear: Clear the activity log shown here (the log files are kept).
ToolTips.Environment > SCCM Site > Test connectio: Connect to the SMS Provider and read the site's name and version. Changes nothing.
ToolTips.Environment > SCCM Site > Detect server: Find the SMS Provider server for this site code.
ToolTips.Environment > SCCM Site > After \"Pull f: On: after a successful pull, older local version folders of that application are deleted.
ToolTips.Environment > SCCM Site > Reload data ev: On: every tab reloads from SCCM when you select it. Off: data loads once; use Refresh / F5.
ToolTips.New device collection > Create: Create the collection (the exact New-CMDeviceCollection command is shown first).
